task.next: Owner finalized approved SD-FND-002. Shared foundation envelope pilot is committed at 94264bc with BFF and runtime-manager adoption evidence; tests passed 59/59.
review_notes_zh: Foundation envelope 已正確接到 BFF /api/v1/operator/commands 與 runtime-manager kill-switch 兩條 pilot path：TraceContext 從 X-Trace-Id/X-Correlation-Id/X-Idempotency-Key headers 傳遞、CommandEnvelope/IdempotencyRecord/PolicyDecision/AuditAction 都有產生並落地、duplicate submission 透過 receipt_id replay 不會產生第二筆 command/audit、不同 payload 但同 idempotency key 時回 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT；policy denial 與 validation error 已用共享 ErrorEnvelope 包裝且帶 trace。Reviewer 重跑 pytest services/control-plane/bff/test_governance_command_submission.py services/runtime-manager/test_runtime_manager.py services/foundation/tests -q => 59 passed in 2.96s，與 owner handoff 宣稱的 59 passed in 3.08s 一致。

本次 diff 同時帶入三組 SD-FND-002 packet 範圍以外但相鄰的 hardening：(1) BFF CORS middleware (受 PANTHEON_BFF_CORS_ORIGINS gating)；(2) _ensure_live_broker_scope_allowed live broker guard (受 PANTHEON_LIVE_BROKER_ENABLED gating)；(3) runtime-manager kill_switch.json 的 atomic tmp+rename 寫入與 corrupt-file quarantine。三者各自有測試覆蓋且不破壞既有測試，故不阻擋本次 review，但建議後續以獨立任務追蹤，避免 foundation 採納 與 broker-scope policy/kill-switch persistence reform 混在同一條改動線上。
Kill-switch 持久化順序由「binding action 之前」改為「binding action 之後」，仍滿足 §11.2 durable-write-precede-ack（return 前已 persist），但 crash 半路時會少落一筆 idempotency ledger，建議後續補 crash-recovery 測試。
